root.label: Alan Jones trial cross-examination of complainant A

events.label: Alan Jones trial cross-examination of complainant A

slots.name: victim age at incident
slots.sentence: The youngest complainant in the trial has told the court he was 17 when Jones allegedly put his tongue inside his mouth and touched him on the bottom during a visit to the shock jock’s property in the Southern Highlands.

slots.name: number of complainants
slots.sentence: Complainant A is one of five men who allege Jones indecently assaulted or sexually touched them between 2003 and 2020.

slots.name: number of charges
slots.sentence: The host has pleaded not guilty to 21 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching.

slots.name: cross examination duration
slots.sentence: Jones’s barrister, Gabrielle Bashir SC, has been cross-examining the young man for two days about the extent of his mother’s involvement in the hundreds of emails which were sent to Jones between 2013 and 2016.

slots.name: complainant age at contract
slots.sentence:
After hours of detailed questions about whether the complainant wrote a specific email about a contract more than a decade ago, Judge Glenn Walsh intervened.
“He can’t approve a contract; he is 14 years of age,” Walsh said.

slots.name: financial assistance provided
slots.sentence: The court heard one email Jones sent to A when he was 16 years of age said he had provided in excess of $100,000, “the cost is out of hand” and needs to come to an end.

slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: The witness has given evidence that he did not consent to the kiss from Jones in 2017 and that he had pulled away, saying “Enough Alan. Good night.”
